home.amuni_text:
Welcome, O traveler, to the edge of time,
where history breathes in every gust of wind.
Hear the call of ancient, solemn stones,
guardians of tales, of ladies, of ancient prayers.

Do not halt your steps, mirror yourself in this magic,
Amunì, come, I shall show you the way.
home.castellana_intro_text: Speak with the Castellana: your multilingual tour guide to discover history, unreleased gems, and taste itineraries among the wonders of the village and the surrounding territory.
home.scan_qr: Scan the QR code to install the app

citizen.intro_text: The beating heart of Amunì lies within those who live in the village every day. Guardians of ancient stories, passed-down flavors, and secrets hidden among stones and alleys.
citizen.legends_desc: The oldest stories of the village, passed down from generation to generation.
citizen.legend_pizzarrone: The Legend of the Pizzarrone Tower
citizen.audio_title: Listen to prayers and tales in dialect
citizen.castle_desc: A millenary fortress: conspiracies, loopholes, secret tunnels, prisons, and epic battles.
citizen.church_desc: A journey through catacombs, traditions, patron saints, and ancient devotions.
citizen.food_desc: Authentic flavors, places to eat, and live the village life.
citizen.food_cocktail: Cocktails with DJ all year round

castle.title: The Castle of Caccamo
castle.rhyme_1:
Welcome, O travelers, to the mighty manor,
gazing over the valley and history ever after.
Perched on the mountain of proud live stone,
guardian of dreams, of glory, and mysteries unknown.
castle.rhyme_2:
Within these walls that challenge all time,
dynasties passed like a breath in the night.
From the fierce, adventurous Chiaramonte lords,
every room tells of treaties, splendor, and swords.
castle.rhyme_3:
Look not for dates in cold, heavy books,
but for the shadow dancing as the candle flickers.
The Castellana awaits you, along the path and the way,
to unveil the secret Sister Felicia holds to this day.
castle.welcomemsg_felicia: Welcome to the Castle of Caccamo, stranger. I am Sister Felicia. Would you like me to reveal the secrets of the Conspiracy Hall, or do you prefer to listen to the ancient legends of the manor? Pray, ask me.
castle.position: A fortress perched on a rocky spur, with a dominant view over the valley.
castle.defense: Loopholes, thick walls, and patrol walkways tell the story of its defensive function.
castle.conspiracy: Secret rooms and noble chambers were the stage for medieval conspiracies and intrigues.
castle.prisons: The underground prisons still preserve the traces of ancient incarcerations.
castle.legend_brothers: The legend of the two brothers tells of a fatal duel for the love of a lady.

monuments.btn_dindondan: Explore Churches on Din Don Dan
monuments.church_notice: ⚠️ Note: The places of worship are active and dedicated to liturgical functions. For tourist visits, please respect the recommended hours and avoid times of internal celebration.

castello.title: The Castle of Caccamo
castello.description: The Castle of Caccamo is among the largest and best-preserved Norman fortresses in Sicily. Perched on live rock since the 11th century, it dominates the San Leonardo valley with its imposing walls, watchtowers, and suggestive internal halls that evoke centuries of feudal history and chivalric legends.

badia.title: Church of San Benedetto alla Badia
badia.description: A true jewel of Sicilian Baroque, the church is world-famous for its extraordinary floor entirely made of 18th-century majolica, depicting allegorical scenes and naturalistic motifs of rare mastery. A masterpiece of visual art suspended in time.
badia.hours: Tue - Sun: 09:00 – 12:30 | Mon: 14:30 – 18:30 (No regular functions, ideal for visits)
badia.tickets: Full € 2.00 | Reduced € 1.00 (EU Youth 18-25 years or with same-day Castle ticket) | Free under 18

santamaria.title: Church of Santa Maria degli Angeli
santamaria.description: Founded in the 15th century along with the Dominican convent, the Church of Santa Maria degli Angeli is one of the most important spiritual centers of the village. It houses the remains and relics of Blessed Giovanni Liccio, Patron Saint of Caccamo. Inside, visitors can admire splendid marble altars and sacred artworks that bear witness to centuries of deep devotion and pilgrimages.
santamaria.hours: Opening and Visits: Saturday from 16:00 to 17:30 | Sunday from 09:00 to 10:00 and from 11:00 to 12:30. (Holy Masses: Saturday 17:30 | Sunday 10:00).

sangiorgio.title: Church of San Giorgio Martire
sangiorgio.description: The Mother Church of Caccamo, dedicated to Saint George the Martyr, is an imposing masterpiece that dominates the monumental square below the Castle. Founded in the Norman era and rebuilt in 1614, it preserves an immense artistic heritage: from Gaginiano school sculptures to precious 17th-century canvases by Flemish painter Matthias Stom, up to rich chapels decorated in mixed marbles.
sangiorgio.hours: Visit Time Slots: Saturday and Sunday 09:30 – 10:45 and 16:00 – 18:00. (Tourist reception is suspended during Sunday Holy Mass at 11:00).

annunziata.title: SS. Annunziata Parish
annunziata.description: Embedded in the medieval urban fabric, the church stands out for its facade and the atmosphere of profound spirituality felt inside. It preserves finely decorated altars and artistic artifacts that attract both visitors and worshippers.
annunziata.hours: Mon - Sat: 09:00 – 12:00 | Weekday Masses at 18:00. Sunday and Holidays visit slots: 08:30 - 09:30 and 10:30 - 12:00 (Festive Masses at 09:30, 12:00, 19:00).

cappuccini.title: Convent of the Capuchin Friars
cappuccini.description: A place of silence, meditation, and history, the structures of the Convent are deeply linked to the Franciscan tradition in Sicily. Beyond the conventual structure, the area offers an authentic insight into monastic life and popular devotion.
cappuccini.hours: Accessible mainly upon request or during Franciscan celebrations. Contact the Tourism Office.
cappuccini.secret_info: 💡 Hidden Gems of Caccamo: The village is home to 33 churches. Use the Din Don Dan map and zoom in on Caccamo to discover real-time hours and openings of lesser-known treasures like the Church of San Rocco and other small widespread masterpieces.

chiese_page.poesia_intro:
Five temples of stone, of faith and memory,
open their gates onto a centuries-old history.
chiese_page.verse_angeli:
At the Angeli rests, in the most sacred silence,
Blessed Giovanni, the village's true icon.
chiese_page.verse_badia:
If you walk down to the Badia, the earth turns to blossom
in the majolica embroidery of rare, wondrous custom.
chiese_page.verse_duomo:
Enter the grand Duomo, majestic and sublime,
amid Gagini's marbles and Stomer's art outlasting time.
chiese_page.verse_annunziata:
Then the Annunziata reveals its painted skies,
and the bell tower never conquered by guards' watchful eyes.
chiese_page.verse_cappuccini:
Climb finally to the Cappuccini, on the hill so bright,
between an Altarpiece and a panoramic view of pure delight.
chiese_page.poesia_outro: Let yourself be guided where time has stood still...

transport_page.welcome: Welcome, O traveler, to the Transportation section. Here you will find the necessary information to move your steps around the village.
transport_page.company_desc: The bus lines connect Caccamo to Termini Imerese and Palermo all year round. By taking the afternoon run towards Palermo, it is possible to be dropped off at Vetrana, a renowned beach area. From Termini Imerese, you can also catch the train to Cefalù and other tourist destinations.
transport_page.stop_1: Porta Euracea: in front of Bar Giallombardo and the building materials shop.
transport_page.stop_2: Viale Regione Siciliana: above the 'Roberta' playground (near the Axa insurance agency).
transport_page.stop_3: Piazza Cappuccini: under the shadow of the ancient Convent.
